item.title: Women’s sports headline Maryland athletics’ record-setting Giving Day
item.description: Maryland generated gifts totaling more than $632,000 for Giving Day, the highest amount raised during the annual fundraising event.

item.title: Maryland women’s basketball leaned too heavily on freshmen in Big Ten tourney loss to Oregon
item.description: Frese said the postseason provided her freshmen with a chance to get a feel for tournament play. So she tested them early on Thursday.

item.title: No. 12 Maryland men’s lacrosse rides first-quarter outburst to 13-8 win over Delaware
item.description: The Terps scored the game's first five goals to help them overcome 19 turnovers and snap a three-game skid.

item.title: Maryland softball collapses and loses Big Ten-opener to Rutgers, 6-5, in 12 innings
item.description: The Terps hit .133 with two outs, squandering a chance for a win to open Big Ten play.

item.title: Offensive woes overshadow Lance Williams’ 10 strikeouts in Maryland baseball’s 5-2 loss to Troy
item.description: The Terps pieced together seven hits, though their only extra base knock came with two outs in Friday's ninth inning.

item.title: No. 3 Maryland women’s lacrosse stifles James Madison in 13-6 win
item.description: The Terps conceded a season-low 23 shot attempts and 16 shots on goal.

item.title: Logan Hastings shuts the door in Maryland baseball’s 9-3 win over Troy
item.description: The right-hander struck out eight Trojans over three innings while earning the save.

item.title: Megan Bingham paces Maryland gymnastics in first-place finish at Maryland Quad
item.description: The senior led Maryland in two out of four events at Xfinity Center.

item.title: UPDATED: Power returns to some UMD buildings after campuswide outage
item.description: It is unclear how the outage started as of 12 a.m. Sunday. Videos circulating on YikYak after 11 p.m. on a Saturday show a power line explosion near campus.
